label: pjm 117 netrev margin
definition: KEEPER (2026-07-24, owner decision). MARGIN arm of the gas-offer net-revenue-margin A/B: pjm-115/gasshape-interpfix recipe + gas_offer_net_revenue_margin=True (anchor 3.3483 $/MMBtu). Adopts the fixed net-revenue-margin form as the correct offer-curve structure (gas-invariant markup, elasticity 1->0, zero new free params). Currently NOT-YET at inherited pjm-115 levels: C1 CC_REGULAR 2023 -8.9 TWh and C3a 2025 -10.6% fail load-bearing gates (fixed margin firms CC offers out of merit at below-anchor gas), C3b shape degrades within tolerance. Open model-misses to close by re-tuning offer-curve LEVELS around the structure (rule 1). BASE control: pjm-116-netrev-base.
market_story: Gas generators bid to earn a target net-revenue MARGIN over marginal cost -- a fixed $/MWh spread reflecting opportunity cost / going-forward margin -- not a markup that mechanically scales with the delivered gas price. The fuel-scaled multiplier form balloons the markup when gas is high (the NEISO winter-overshoot artifact); the net-revenue-margin form removes that by holding the markup fixed at the measured-anchor level and letting only the physical fuel burn track delivered gas. This is the structurally faithful bidding model; the current C1/C3a misses are a LEVEL calibration gap (the inherited multiplier levels were fit under the old multiplier form and over-firm CC at below-anchor gas), addressed by re-tuning levels around the structure -- not a defect of the structure itself.
